Five of today's (8:10, 8:30, 9:07, 9:36, 9:50 ET) have no push failure anywhere near them. waiter-claude-bot.log and waiter-codex-bot.log logged nothing from 15:48:22Z to 15:59:19Z, then 4 `orch job run exited 0` lines in the same second the poller resumed (10:59:09 ET); the same pattern at 16:28:55Z to 16:35:04Z. A copy of orch.db has no row written by any box process inside either gap. The kernel log (shared host kernel; the box is a container on kvm-clock) has systemd-journald killed by its watchdog at 11:34:52 ET, 5 s before the poller resumed, its 11th restart.

choice: test_a_poll_cycle_push_that_times_out_keeps_cycles_on_time_and_leaves_no_ssh: a real PollLoop and PollPusher start a real push child whose fake scp runs a fake ssh child, and both hang past a 2 s timeout
